free_tier_limits.correction: Basic plan: 25,000 map views and 5,000 each for static maps, place search, navigation, and elevation per month; one custom style; non-commercial use only on publicly available sites without login.

rate_limits.correction: Per account and IP: Maps 100 requests/second; Static Maps, Elevation, Places, and Routing each 1 request/second.

description.correction: The listed services are current, but the free Basic plan is limited to non-commercial use on publicly available websites without login, rather than general light production use.

notes: Official docs currently show access-token as a query parameter. I found no official support for the entry's separate Authorization: Bearer claim, although auth_type=apiKey remains appropriate. The API and documentation appear active in 2026.
